title: 1RB0LE_0RC0RA_1RD1RF_1LA0LD_1LD0RF_1RB---: every left-end tick of the first 10<sup>10</sup> steps proved in Lean
text: The last 6 left-end ticks without a proof all come before step 274,716 and have at most one block after the front, too few for the general rules. Each is now a concrete run checked by the kernel. With the 198 front-rule ticks and the 54 copy ticks, all 258 left-end ticks of the first 10<sup>10</sup> steps have a Lean proof.
